claim_one_line: B997-S OWED CHECK DISCHARGED: THE CONDUCTOR IDENTIFICATION IS RIGHT, AND CONDUCTOR NAMES TWO THINGS. B997 proved the golden is the UNIQUE metallic grammar whose own-conductor shadow group is a McKay group, conditional on conductor = m^2+4 which it flagged as INFERRED from two data points and not proved canonical. THE CHECK IS DISCHARGED AND THE ANSWER IS BOTH: the corpus already contains the definition in a banked LAW (B675) which uses CONDUCTOR for a DIFFERENT quantity than B666 does -- B675-s CUSP ORDER-S conductor is golden 4 and silver 2, while B666-s word-s own conductor (the shadow modulus) is golden 5 and silver 8. TWO DISTINCT QUANTITIES BOTH CALLED CONDUCTOR IN ADJACENT LAWS, a live terminology collision, and it is why the check looked open when the answer was banked. B997 used the SECOND, and m^2+4 reproduces it exactly (m=1 gives 5, m=2 gives 8), so B997-s identification is CORRECT AS THE SHADOW MODULUS and the flagged condition is discharged. AND B675 SUPPLIES THE MECHANISM B997 LACKED: the QUANTIZATION-INDEX LAW states the mod-shadow reduction is an ISOMORPHISM iff the conductor is COPRIME to the shadow and has a KERNEL LINE iff ramified -- so golden gcd(4,5)=1 gives ISO while silver gcd(2,8)=2 gives RAMIFIED. THEREFORE THE GOLDEN-S SHADOW IS THE McKAY GROUP BECAUSE BOTH INDEPENDENT CONDITIONS HOLD: (1) |SL(2,Z/5)| = 120 = |2I| with N in {3,4,5} the COMPLETE list, proved in B997 via |SL(2,Z/N)| >= (6/pi^2)N^3 > 120 for N >= 6; and (2) gcd(4,5) = 1 so the reduction is an ISOMORPHISM, B675-s law. The silver satisfies NEITHER: 8 is not a McKay order, and gcd(2,8) = 2 makes the reduction ramified, which is exactly why 2O appears ONE QUOTIENT DOWN rather than as the shadow itself. B666 stated the FACT, B675 stated the MECHANISM, B997 supplied the UNIQUENESS -- and none of the three cited the other two; they are now joined. CONSEQUENCES: B997-s condition (ii) is DISCHARGED, its conductor identification correct as the shadow modulus from a BANKED LAW rather than two matching values; B997 is STRENGTHENED not merely confirmed, its uniqueness now carrying a MECHANISM (the golden is the only metallic word where the shadow modulus is a McKay order AND the reduction is unramified); and a TERMINOLOGY COLLISION is registered, since conductor names both the cusp order-s conductor (B675) and the shadow modulus (B666), so any future arc using the word must say which -- the same class as the T1 collision cc3 found and the twelve things called the wall. SCOPE: still TIER 1, predicting none of the 19 numbers, and still the E8 end (2I) not E6, the E6 arrival remaining class-level by B993; what changed is that the uniqueness is no longer conditional on an inferred definition.
